patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width white backgrounds and full-width deep purple/blue backgrounds, creating clear visual breaks and grouping related content.
A vibrant green/teal and a bright yellow/orange are used sparingly as accent colors for star ratings, small labels, and subtle highlights against the dominant deep purple/blue and white palette.
Headings use a bold, modern sans-serif font, often in a larger size for impact, while body text maintains high legibility with a slightly lighter weight sans-serif.
Key information and calls to action are frequently presented within distinct, rounded-corner cards or panels, often featuring a subtle shadow for depth.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, ensuring constant access to key site links and calls to action.

technique_notes: The layout uses a consistent max-width container for content within full-bleed background sections, ensuring readability and structure across varying screen sizes.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature subtle rounded corners and clear hover states, often using the primary accent colors for visual feedback.
The motion system employs a standard sticky header, where the navigation bar maintains its position at the top of the screen while the rest of the page content scrolls underneath it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and content cards, creating a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, with a slightly denser arrangement for feature grids and card layouts.

standout: The site effectively uses a vibrant, almost neon green and yellow as secondary accents against a deep, rich purple and dark blue, creating a modern and energetic feel without being overwhelming. The integrated map section with interactive city cards is also a distinctive feature.
